prompt:
Desktop website homepage screenshot, first viewport, 1536x1024 landscape, for lumiverse.hr (LumiVerse, an AI product studio in Zagreb). A real-time 3D website: UI overlay composited over a live 3D scene. It must read clearly as a website homepage, not a standalone render.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1. Top navigation bar, thin, full width, transparent over the scene. Left: wordmark "LumiVerse" in white medium grotesk with a small coral #FF4D4D dot beside it. Centre-right nav links in small white sans: "Work   Services   Research   Studio   Contact". Far right: "EN / HR" in small grey text.
2. Left column (roughly the left 40%), upper left: a very large, heavy, tightly tracked white grotesk headline on three lines: "We build" / "Better" / "Humans." It is the largest element on the page. Below it one line of smaller light-grey body text: "Senior AI studio in Zagreb. Ambitious products, shipped and checked." Below that, a solid coral #FF4D4D rectangular button with white text "Start a Project →" and next to it a plain white text link with underline "Explore the model".
3. Centre-right (roughly the right 60%): the 3D scene. A dark gallery space, walls #0E0F12, floor #1C1D21, one raking warm spotlight from the upper right with subtle volumetric haze in the beam. On a low matte plinth sits an architect's presentation maquette made of white card #EDEBE7 and basswood #C9A57A, three distinct abstract models side by side:
   (a) left: a small storefront-like building with a canopy shaped like a speech bubble;
   (b) centre, tallest: a slender layered tower of 17 thin stacked slabs alternating white card and basswood;
   (c) right: a delicate wire-frame sphere floating above a small round glass lens on a basswood stand.
   Tiny human scale figures painted coral #FF4D4D stand among the models, architect-model style, a handful of them.
   Cinematic shallow depth of field, soft long shadows from the spotlight, precise craft, museum quality.
4. Thin hairline white leader lines with small uppercase monospace labels point to each model: "MOJ KOLEGA" to the storefront, "BRIDJ · 17 services" to the tower, "AIR-LASER · computed, not built" to the sphere.
5. Bottom right corner: a small grey hint "drag to orbit" with a tiny orbit icon.

Style: premium, quiet, editorial, gallery-like. Not toy-like, not sci-fi, no neon, no glow effects, no purple gradients. Coral appears ONLY on the tiny figures, the logo dot and the CTA button. All UI text crisp, correctly spelled and readable. No other text, no extra logos, no prices, no claims.
